title: Jazzy American Hash with Crispy Lard
description: A twist on a classic American recipe, this dish combines crispy lard with jazzy spices and a crunchy hash.
instructions: In a large pan, heat the lard over medium heat.
Add the hash to the pan and cook until crispy, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle the jazzy spice blend over the hash and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the hash to a baking dish and bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and serve hot.
